reuse.why: Adds the option to the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories selection that all six month-wide actions already use, rather than adding per-action filtering.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is toggled in one place; a shared MonthWideArgs type avoids repeating the argument shape.

placement.why: The flag is handled inside the category-selection helper in budget/actions.ts, where the tree already decides which categories month-wide actions touch.

scope.why: Only the helper, the month-wide action signatures and tests change; single-category actions are untouched.

maintainability.why: A single named option on the shared selection with a default keeping old behaviour, threaded uniformly and tested for two actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; every month-wide action passes the flag to getMonthWideBudgetCategories
